propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend is missing two required Backend protocol members (query_project and assert_env_ready), causing isinstance checks to fail and inbound passes to raise AttributeError
The reconciler.backend configuration validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' despite the backend being registered, making DC deployments unreachable through configuration
Inbound identity minting for DC assignees silently fails because the guard checks for Cloud's accountId field which DC users lack entirely (they carry name/key instead)
DC-created tickets must be minted under the shared 'jira' creation channel and family identity provider to avoid fragmenting store vocabulary per deployment and requiring a migration
A writing reconcile pass against Jira Data Center crashes with 'set_entity_property' AttributeError because the core calls this method from three sites but TicketTransport protocol never declared it
The live test harness requires local provisioning (rebar.toml with base_url, allow_insecure=true, and JIRA_PAT environment variable) beyond what the DC harness conftest provides
